title: Energy Department gives X-energy $80M to start Xe-100 reactor demo

sources.quote: DOE is awarding TerraPower LLC (Bellevue, Washington) and X-energy (Rockville, Maryland) $80 million each in initial funding to build two advanced nuclear reactors that can be operational within seven years.

explain: The Energy Department granted X-energy $80 million in first-year money to build a demonstration of its Xe-100 small gas-cooled reactor, part of a program DOE said could total $3.2 billion over seven years for two projects.
